question.value: What are the gas fractions, depletion times, sizes and morphologies of massive ALMA-selected galaxies at z~2-3 in GOODS-South, and do they support a slow exhaustion of gas as the path to quiescence?

evidence.quote: In $\S$[5](#sec:slow_death), we discuss the results and interpret them as the evidence for a slow downfall of star formation in $z\sim2-3$ massive galaxies.

results_numeric.quantity: Fraction of galaxies below the f_gas-R_SB relation

evidence.quote: we find a surprisingly large fraction (40%) of galaxies lying well below this relation
with a median of f$_{gas}$ = 0.52 (mean = 0.52)
The depletion times span a large range, between 30 and 1600 Myr.
we find that ALMA sizes are generally smaller, with a median $r_{e,\text{HST}}$/$r_{e,\text{ALMA}}$ = 2.3.
61% (11/18) of our galaxies are classified as irregulars/mergers

findings_qualitative.value: ALMA-detected galaxies are mostly starbursts or upper main sequence; 54% have R_SB>3

evidence.quote: 54% of them have a R$_{SB}$(SFR/SFR$_{MS}$) $>$ 3

claims.hypothesis: Massive ALMA galaxies have low gas fractions and short depletion times
claims.experiment: Gas masses from dust masses and GDR compared to Tacconi+2018 scaling relations
claims.result: About half follow the relation; 40% lie well below, with short depletion times
claims.finding: A large fraction are exhausting their gas, consistent with slow downfall/starvation, AGN possibly involved

evidence.quote: we find a surprisingly large fraction (40%) of galaxies lying well below this relation

claims.hypothesis: ALMA-selected galaxies are progenitors of compact z~2 ellipticals
claims.experiment: Compared ALMA 1.1 mm sizes and HST 5000 A sizes
claims.result: Dust sizes ~2.3 times smaller than optical sizes
claims.finding: Compact obscured star formation will make them compact

evidence.quote: compact dust-obscured star formation (at least more compact than optical emission) is taking place in the core of the galaxies studied here

claims.experiment: CNN morphologies vs a control sample

evidence.quote: The galaxy population detected by ALMA, therefore, tends to be on average biased toward irregular galaxies.

limitations_admitted.value: Gas mass uncertainties are large; metallicity assumed; selection bias in small survey

evidence.quote: We keep in mind that the uncertainties on the determination of $M_{gas}$ are large, taking into account all of the assumptions used.

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas masses depend on assumed GDR-metallicity relation with metallicity from mass only
Low gas fractions may reflect AGN bias in stellar mass
